verdict.rationale: Shortcut ships an official MCP server, maintained in its own GitHub org (useshortcut/mcp-server-shortcut). Its docs include a setup guide for connecting Codex CLI through "the Shortcut MCP server" and promote connecting agents like Cursor and Claude Code. Missing for 10: documentation of the exposed tools/capabilities and auth/hosting details, plus independent or hands-on corroboration of the server working.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Setup guide for connecting Codex CLI to Shortcut through the Shortcut MCP server.
This allows you to instantly test changes to the MCP server without having to publish a new version.
Connect Shortcut to tools like Cursor and Claude Code to get agents coding and synced to GitHub.
